request.prompt:
Use case: photorealistic-natural. One real photograph for a Spanish-speaking adult beginner learning English. Natural everyday photographic detail, real material, skin, wood and fabric texture, soft natural daylight and correct perspective; NOT an illustration, 3D render, cartoon, collage, cutout or app UI. Full-bleed 3:2 landscape; no frames, padding, blur bands, vignette, watermark or captions. A first-time learner must understand the picture instantly on a small phone screen. Do not imitate earlier course photos.

A CHOICE between two things. On a plain, clean, light-gray table, photographed from directly above, lie two objects far apart: on the LEFT one yellow wooden pencil with a pink eraser, and on the RIGHT one closed spiral notebook with a plain bright-blue cover. Between them, in the exact middle of the photo, one adult hand reaches in from the bottom edge with the palm up and the fingers open in a clear 'which one?' gesture: the hand touches neither object and is the same distance from both. The pencil, the hand and the notebook are all sharp and large, each clearly separate. Nothing else is on the table: no pen, no paper, no book. No letters, words, numbers, logos or brand marks anywhere. The hand has five natural fingers.

cost.basis: Reported usage at list prices checked 2026-09-24; before tax, not an invoice.
